externalCreateHint: This form creates a record in the project's external source. To work in a group, start a group Thread classified under this project instead.
threadChooseGroupHint: Choose the group for this Thread, then enter its work information.
threadNewGroupHint: A new group initially includes only you. You can add members later.
threadHomeHint: Choose a storage location and optional project, then select the owning group and enter the work information. Projects do not change group membership or discussion.
threadCreateFailed: The Thread was not created. Check the form and try again.
threadSourceUnavailable: The selected location is unavailable. Reconnect or choose another location.
threadParentUnavailable: The parent Thread is no longer available. Close and select it again.
threadGroupStatus: Threads use shared statuses. This Thread will start in Inbox.
threadParentRequiresGroup: The parent must be converted to a group Thread before adding a child Thread.
loadFailed: Groups could not be loaded. Please retry.
joinAndLinkTitle: Join the Thread and link this task
joinAndLinkDescription: Join “{{title}}” in “{{group}}” and link your existing task. You will receive ongoing notifications, which you can mute or leave in the Thread.
projectCreationUnavailable: This project cannot be linked right now. Choose another editable project or no project.
taskLinkRecoveryFailed: Linking failed and the previous link could not be restored. Select the Thread to link again.
taskReplaceAssociation: Link this task to the selected Thread, replacing its previous link. Your private conversation stays private.
taskLinkDescription: Link this task to an existing Thread or start a new one. Private conversations remain private; deliveries require explicit publication.
taskNewThreadDescription: Review the public work information, then link your existing task.
workLoadFailed: Work records could not be loaded. Try again.
threadLinkUnavailable: This Thread could not be opened. It may have been deleted or your access may have changed.
threadReadFailed: Read status could not be updated. Thread content is still available.
emptyHint: Create a group to talk without a project. Start Threads for specific work.
localHint: Groups on this device are private to you. Choose Team to collaborate with others.
emptyThreadChat: Discuss this Thread here. Its conversation stays in this room.
viewerObserverHint: Join to receive notifications according to your settings. Your role allows viewing history and deliveries.
observerHint: You can read history and deliveries. Join to discuss and receive alerts according to your notification settings.
messagePlaceholder: Send a message, type @ to mention members
readOnly: This group is read-only. You can still read its history.
participantBoundary: Group members can read. Join to discuss and receive alerts according to your notification settings.
invalidDates: Due time cannot be earlier than start time
tagsHelp: Press Enter or comma to add a tag
projectBoundary: Projects classify and aggregate work. Linking does not change the owning group or membership. Changing the project clears its previous milestone.
restrictedMilestones: Project access is required to view the project and its milestones.
milestoneRequiresProject: Link a project to choose one of its milestones.
memberBoundary: New members can read existing group and Thread discussions and deliveries. Invitations grant group access only, without project, device or private agent permissions.
saveBeforeClassify: Resolve unsaved changes before changing the project link.
classificationPermission: Changing a link requires work classification permissions in the group and both the previous and new projects.
discardDescription: Your unsaved changes will be lost when leaving this page.
messageUnavailable: This message was deleted or is unavailable.
autosaveProperties: Properties save automatically. Save the description separately.
